results.snippet: RFC 8252 OAuth 2.0 for Native Apps October 2017 The PKCE [RFC7636] protocol was created specifically to mitigate this attack. It is a proof-of-possession extension to OAuth 2.0 that protects the authorization code from being used if it is intercepted.
